title.hr: Dozvole kažu da, SELinux kaže ne
title.en: DAC says yes, SELinux says no

concept.hr: Druga provjera nakon dozvola, po oznakama: tip, politika, način rada
concept.en: A second, label-based check after permissions: type, policy, mode

summary.hr: Proces pokušava pristup: prvo dozvole, pa politika po paru tipova, pa način rada. Promijeni oznaku ili način rada i pokušaj ponovno.
summary.en: A process tries an access: permissions first, then the policy by the type pair, then the mode. Change a label or the mode and retry.

title.en: setenforce 0: a switch, not a fix

concept.hr: U načinu permissive radnja prolazi, a odbijanje se i dalje bilježi
concept.en: In permissive mode the action goes through, and the denial is still logged

title.hr: cp i mv s oznakom postupaju različito
title.en: cp and mv treat the label differently

concept.hr: Oznaka pripada datoteci: mv je nosi sa sobom, restorecon je vraća
concept.en: The label belongs to the file: mv carries it along, restorecon resets it
